reconcile.note: Clarke harmonizes the sequence by positing two separate divine calls, one given in Mesopotamia before Haran and a second renewed in Haran itself.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells (Skeptic's Annotated Bible) catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (Skeptic's Annotated Bible), Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "Did God call Abraham before or after he moved to Haran?" (skepticsannotatedbible.com/contra/haran.html) (2013).

sides.snippet: They went forth from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran, and lived there.
sides.verseText: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son's son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram's wife. They went forth from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran, and lived there.

sides.snippet: The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
sides.verseText: He said, \"Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
